notes: For police, Fire Services Department or ambulance help, dial 999. People with speech or hearing impairment can send an SMS to 992. Source: https://www.gov.hk/en/nonresidents/visitinghk/usefulinfo/emergency.htm (GovHK: Getting Emergency Help), retrieved 2026-09-26.
